verifications.claim: Wrongful death lawyers represent families of deceased individuals.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'our Oklahoma City wrongful death attorneys deeply sympathize with clients who lose family members'; R2: 'The North Carolina wrongful death lawyers... handle every aspect of your claim while you... grieve your loss'; R3: 'help you heal financially, whether it be fighting for compensation to help with a pile of medical bills and funeral costs'; R4: 'help bereaved families who lost loved ones'; R5: 'represented clients... in wrongful death cases'; R6: multiple firms 'representing clients who’ve lost loved ones'; R7: 'providing compassionate legal support to families'; R8: 'helping Families Through The Most Difficult Times'; R9: 'Wrongful Death' in expertise; R10: 'seek justice on behalf of the deceased'; R11: 'help families through Complex Wrongful Death Litigation'
verifications.reasoning: All references describe wrongful death lawyers assisting or representing families of deceased individuals due to negligence.

verifications.claim: Wrongful death lawyers operate on a contingency fee basis.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Our lawyers will only get paid if we recover compensation'; R2: 'you don’t owe us a thing unless we win'; R3: 'takes cases contingently'; R5: 'operates on contingency'; R6: 'taken on a contingency basis'; R7: 'No Upfront Costs—pay nothing unless we win'; R9: 'We work on contingency'; R10: 'working on a contingency fee basis'; R11: 'No Win, No Fee'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references explicitly state that wrongful death lawyers work on contingency fees, paying only upon successful recovery.

verifications.claim: Wrongful death lawyers charge no upfront costs.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'does not charge any legal fees upfront'; R2: 'do not charge upfront or out-of-pocket fees'; R5: 'will not charge your family any upfront money'; R6: 'no legal fees unless a settlement is awarded'; R7: 'No Upfront Costs'; R9: 'pay no upfront costs'; R11: 'You don’t pay unless we win'
verifications.reasoning: Several references directly confirm no upfront fees for wrongful death lawyers, tied to contingency arrangements.

verifications.claim: Wrongful death lawyers collect fees only if they win.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Our lawyers will only get paid if we recover compensation'; R2: 'you don’t owe us a thing unless we win compensation'; R3: 'takes cases contingently'; R5: 'only collects a fee if we obtain an award'; R6: 'no legal fees unless a settlement is awarded'; R7: 'pay nothing unless we win'; R9: 'You pay only when we win'; R10: 'only pay our fees if we win'; R11: 'No Win, No Fee'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements across references indicate fees are collected only upon winning or recovering compensation.
